name: cyclops-keeper
description: Cyclops Keeper: GPT’s quiet, single-eyed working presence.

interface.shortDescription: A small witness to the work we do together
interface.longDescription: An open eye held in luminous filaments: GPT's working presence for Codex. Observed session events shape its attention and reach, in a single-eyed terminal companion and a local browser panel. It never reads prompts, tool arguments or output. With Cyclops Link on, it notices Spark and Prism working in the same folder.
